note: Expected findings are the code, path, message and suggestion `orb validate` (the Rust validator) reports for the same program. Cases copy the tests of validate_expectation_links in tests/expectations_validation.rs (a_single_orbital_schema_never_reports_unsatisfied, an_absent_provider_is_deferred_not_unsatisfied, the expected-event trio, the strict entity/identity/event/page set, the spec orbital pair, a_state_expectation_needs_the_provider_trait_to_declare_it, a_transition_expectation_needs_that_edge_in_the_provider_trait) and tests/expects_page_slice.rs (the boot/route page tests); the rest pin the strict config knob and bare identity arms and the StringOrArray `from`. Not covered by this rule: a strict persistent entity nothing writes and a strict event the trait declares but never fires, which stay in the compiler.
